title: Changelog & Updates
subtitle: Track the latest updates, feature releases, and bug fixes across all VibePress Studio products.

entries.version: v0.3.0 — Brand Redesign, Studio Lab & Contrast Polish
changes: Integrated complete Google Stitch Design System with custom color tokens, Inter/JetBrains Mono typography, and responsive layouts.
Renamed top navigation menu from 'Marketplace' to 'Studio' and migrated page route from /pricing to /lab.
Added permanent 301 redirect from /pricing to /lab ensuring zero broken links and full backward compatibility.
Added SVG brand logo to Header, Mobile Drawer, and Footer, along with modern vector favicon (icon.svg).
Fixed primary button and tab text contrast (--color-primary-foreground: #ffffff) ensuring full WCAG AAA compliance.
Updated SEO sitemap metadata and verified production build for live Vercel deployment.

Replaced all low-contrast Blue (from-blue-600) and Black (from-slate-800/900/950, bg-slate-950) button/gradient backgrounds with high-contrast brand gradients from-primary to-indigo-600 and from-indigo-600 to-violet-600 (page.tsx product headers, products roadmap teaser, shelfmaster licensing, about commitment banner).

Fixed button text legibility: removed opacity-80/90, changed bg-white/10 and bg-white/20 translucent pills to solid bg-white text-primary (v0.2.2 badges, global CTA, roadmap pill, product category labels).
Unified CTAs to bg-primary text-primary-foreground (shelfmaster hero + bottom CTA, readiness badge) and improved FREE/PRO badges (blue-600 → primary, indigo-600 → violet-600) for WCAG AA+ contrast.
Verified build and Vercel deployment live at https://vibepressstudio.vercel.app
Added dual membership KYC feature for waived privilege accounts.
Optimized SQLite query execution reducing RAM usage by 15%.
Fixed an issue with 58mm thermal printer alignment on Linux.
Official launch of the VibePress Studio platform.
Initial release of Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker Pro.
